articles.title: Kuwait • After being targeted by alleged plot from Tehran, interior minister closer than ever to ruling emir
articles.description: On 26 October, Kuwait’s Criminal Court sentenced three individuals to death for their alleged links to Iran. One of them was Hussein Abdallah al-Maatouk, the secretary-general of the Kuwaiti Shia
